entries.f0bbdc01446dc8d9: This business imports cleaning and washing equipment for commercial, industrial and consumer use (environmental cleaning equipment), manufactured to the company's specifications by manufacturers in Europe and the United States, China and others, and sells it throughout Japan. External revenue by product group for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,779 million for cleaning equipment, ¥3,839 million for washing equipment, and ¥3,138 million for others (parts and maintenance services, consumables and accessories, water purifying agents, general home appliances, etc.). It has 20 sales offices and 1 branch office nationwide, and also maintains a logistics center and a testing and research laboratory in Funabashi, Chiba Prefecture.
